buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses The following essential clause be complianced: a) Scope of AMC: The AMC shall cover 102 Nos. PTZ cameras installed at various BO PS under The jurisdiction of Ftr HQ BSF Jammu. A complete location-wise inventory of all 102

Cameras shall be given to the interested vender by visiting this HQr, treated as con fidential in view of security Considerations. The same shall not be disclosed in the tender document of shared with Unauthorized person). b) Preventive maintenance: The frequency and schedule of preventive maintenance shall be once week. The service provider shall submit duly signed maintenance repor ts after each scheduled visit. c) Complaint attendance and Repair: The service Provider shall attend to complaints Regarding malfuncitioning of PTZ Cameras within 24 hours of receipt. In case the def ect cannot be rectified within the stipulated period, an equivalent compatible standb y camera shall be provided without additional service charges till restoration of the or iginal camera. The maximum permissible restoration period shall also be specified. d) Spare parts and consumables: The items covered under Non-comprehensive AMC and spare parts/consumables are included. e) Technical personnel and tools: The service Provider shall arrange suitably qualified technical personnel, necessay tools, testing equipment and transportation for carryin g out the maintenance work, as per the approved scope of Work. f) Security and confidentiality: The service Provider and its personnel shall strictly co mply with BSF security instructions and access procedures. No photography, video re cording, copying or disclosure of surveillance footage, camera configuration of securi ty-related information shall be permitted without prior written authorisation of the co mpetent authority. g) Service Reports and Payment: Half-yearly payment shall be linked with satisfactor y performance of the AMC during the respective period. Submission of prescribed mai ntenance/service reports and certification by the authorized representative of the Bu yer, in accordance with applicable GeM payment terms. h) Contract period: The AMC shall be for a period of 12 months commencing from the date of placing the order in the GeM Contract. The commencement date will be from date of agreement and coverage period shall be 12 months to ensure that no retrosp ective coverage is involved. i) Exclusion of cameras under Warranty/CAMC: It shall be ensured that the instant A MC covers only those 102 PTZ Cameras for which the warranty has expired and which are not already covered under any existing warranty/CAMC arrangement. j) Optional Site Visit: Bidders will be permitted to visit the installation sites, with prior permission and coordination with the concerned BSF authorities, for assessment of th e existing infrastructure. Such visit shall remain optional and shall not be made a pre -condition for participation in the bid. k) EMD Submission and Exemption: The bidders shall submit EMD as prescribed in th e GeM Bid, except those eligible for exemption under the prevailling GeM GTC and ap plicable Government instructions. MSEs having valid Udyam Registration for the rele vant AMC service and DPIIT-recognized Startups shall be eligible for EMD exemption, subject to fulfilment of the prescribed eligibility conditions and submission of valid su pporting documents along with the bid. I) Mere MSE/Startup registration shall not automatically entitle a bidder to EMD exem ption. The exemption shall be admissible only upon verification of eligibility for the te ndered AMC service. II) Failure to submit the prescribed EMD or valid exemption ducuments, as applicable , shall render the bid liable for rejection in accordance with the applicable GeM provis ions. III) EMD shall be submitted through the mode and within the timeline prescribed on t he GeM portal. Physical submission of the original instrument, wherever applicable, s hall be made in favour of IG, Ftr HQ BSF Jammu, payable at SBI, Branch, ACB Jammu, Canal Road, Dist Jammu (J&K). IV) Release/refund of EMD shall be governed by the prevailling GeM GTC. L) Following certificates/undertaking shall be uploaded with the bid documents for w hich sample certificate enclosed

1. EMD/Bid Securing Declaration 2. Undertaking of finance standing 3. Undertaking regarding fake/misleading/edited/forged 4. Turnover certificate last 3 years 5.
